reviews.title: Love this app, but the latest update broke the colors
reviews.text:
I've used Daylio every day for over 1,200 days and I pay for Premium, so I don't write this lightly. Since the 1.77 update, the colors are a mess. Emotion labels in the main feed now show in a heavy black bold that doesn't match anything else on the page. Some mood counts are black and others are white instead of their mood colors. The emotion feed page no longer shows each day's average mood color either, so every day looks the same.

I'm on the latest version. I deleted and reinstalled the app and restored my backup, and nothing changed. Support was kind and passed my screenshots and logs to the developers, but couldn't give a timeline for a fix. The colors are half of what makes looking back at my mood history useful, so please bring them back, or let us pick our own mood colors for this text. I desperately want to return this review to the 5 stars this app deserves.

reviews.title: Missing PDF reports but otherwise superb
reviews.text:
Some method of generating a pdf report to share your data would be good, with options as to what to include so you can share with dr’s.
Otherwise it is excellent.
It does create csv’s which is okay. It would be great if it had full icloud sync and an ipad version but those aren’t essential.

Update: I've been a premium daylio user for years - since 2018 I think, it seems to get lots of additions which I suppose is great, pdf arrived but I haven't tried it, the rest are not for me I don't use any of them they are just bloatware. There are lots of ads built-in too, if I want betterhealth or a private journal or more great apps or whatever else then I can search for them thank you, I don't need adverts, that is what your website or newsletter is for. The latest cosmetic changes are awful, not a fan. It would be really nice if they spent time on something really useful like icloud sync. I'd like to be able to pick up my ipad and add an entry but I can't do that - well I could pick it up, do a restore, then add an entry then do a backup then next time I pick up the iphone do a restore and... Most apps manage to sync using icloud I can't be the only one who has been asking for this for years. But then I suppose surrounding everything in pointless boxes and making it look godawful must be a major priority for someone. It's a wonderful app, don't spoil it.

reviews.title: “New crisp look” visual update issue
reviews.text: I love this app and have adored it for years, but the current “crisp look” update is unpleasant to the eyes, the way the mood is bold white and taking space while the entries are a dim grey and cramped below hurts my eyes and I mean it in a serious way, the mood title’s white is too bright compared to the low opacity of the entry words itself. And I don’t like how the single pictures are now cropped by default unlike before where the square single pictures showed fully. Please at least let us have the choice to revert to the old look. The new update is a bit off putting to my eyes i’m considering stopping my entries after 2000+ entries because of it :(

reviews.title: PDF
reviews.text: The app’s functionality is excellent, but I’m disappointed with the redesigned PDF export. It looks unattractive and is difficult to read. The oversized dates take up far too much space on the page and distract from the important information in the notes, activity icons, and charts.

reviews.title: Be careful with the annual subscription!
reviews.text:
Be very careful before starting the free trial! The app only offers an annual subscription, with no monthly option. I forgot to cancel my trial, but canceled immediately on the same day I was charged and requested a refund through Apple. Apple denied my request, and even after contacting support, they refused to offer any solution, not even a partial refund for the unused months.

Now I’m stuck paying for an entire year of an app I don’t want to use. I’m sharing my experience so other people don’t end up in the same situation. Very frustrating and disappointing!

reviews.title: Toxic positivity
reviews.text: The messages that appear when you save an entry are a brilliant example of toxic positivity. I’m tolerating it atm but am on the hunt for another app.

reviews.title: .Annoying App DAYLIO constantly requests reviews
reviews.text:
DAYLIO App constantly requests to be reviewed - even though I have. 
After submitting a low score review the app began requesting a review 2 times a day. 
I guess someone is unhappy. Developer needs to turn off or Reduce the number of requests for me to review this app. Very frustrating experience.

reviews.title: suggested icon was noose for depressed
reviews.text: i added an emotion to track in order to track my depression, which i have been struggling with for years. the suggested icon was a noose, which felt inappropriate. i’ve only downloaded it today so i don’t have much more thoughts yet, but was excited to use it prior.

reviews.title: Cash grab
reviews.text: Yet another app that primarily exists to convince you to sign up for a “free” trial only to charge you for an entire YEAR, if you forget to cancel in one short week. Just use a digital journal and add your own emoji - save yourself the headache.

reviews.text: There is a recent rollout that added historical tiles —this should be optional and removable to the user. It is really hampering the user experience by pushing days that a person may not want to revisit

reviews.title: Can't disable promotional notifications
reviews.text: I obviously want reminders to update my log, but there's no way to do that without also getting obnoxious promotional notifications too. Disabling advertising notifications should be an option for any application. Very disappointing.
